post.caption: Paul Newman's Rolex said drive carefully. His wife Joanne Woodward gave him a Rolex Daytona around the time he made the racing movie Winning, and she had the case back engraved Drive Carefully Me. He wore it almost every day for about fifteen years. In 1984 she bought him a newer one, and that summer his daughter's boyfriend was rebuilding a treehouse at the family's Connecticut home. Newman noticed the boy had no watch and handed him the Rolex. In 2017 it became the most expensive wristwatch ever sold at auction.
